ops.title: Remove foreground object-index rebuild after repack
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccn_bounded_cache. User-confirmed incident: doc/ledger list orphaned clients blocked on objects SQLite writer after repack; corpus metadata previously measured 27,997,431 objects across575 packs. Next: prove normal read→prepare→reconcile/global transaction path, replace foreground full per-object import with authoritative Git IDX/MIDX targeted access, preserve existing sessions and object authority. Evidence: FE/ccn-ledger-object-index-population.json and parent critical incident message. No live expensive list replay.

ops.text: Ordinary reads after repack avoid corpus-wide per-object SQLite import and global writer lock; bounded correctness/performance CI passes
Merged release is published and installed in root-serialized activation slot without terminating protected sessions
Affected packed-object and list operations verified after installation with bounded positive evidence; no fake-ready or weakened source validation
